name: Visual Spatial Reasoning (VSR)
description: Visual Spatial Reasoning (VSR) is a vision-and-language benchmark designed to evaluate spatial relationship understanding in multimodal models. It consists of 10,972 natural image-caption pairs covering 65 spatial relations across diverse categories (topological, directional, proximity, and projective), grounded in MS-COCO images with human verification.

source_references.title: Visual Spatial Reasoning

verification.notes: Verified against TACL 2023 publication (DOI: 10.1162/tacl_a_00566) and official GitHub repository (cambridgeltl/visual-spatial-reasoning). 10,972 total image-text pairs covering 65 spatial relations. Evaluated via two official protocols: random split (7,680 train, 1,097 dev, 2,195 test) and zero-shot split (evaluating generalization on unseen relations/objects).

size.notes: JSONL files containing image paths, captions, relation types, and binary correctness labels.
